Part III: Biology
The diagram shows a **plant cell** seen under a light microscope. Some parts are labelled with letters.

subs.answer: A: cell wall · B: nucleus · C: (permanent) vacuole

subs.text: Name ++one++ structure found in plant cells but {color:#C0392B}not{/color} in animal cells.
subs.answer: Any one of: cell wall, chloroplast, large permanent vacuole

items.text:
In pea plants (*Pisum sativum*), the allele for tall stems (**T**) is dominant over the allele for short stems (**t**). Two plants with genotype $Tt$ are crossed.
|   | T | t |
|---|---|---|
| T |   |   |
| t |   |   |

subs.answer: TT, Tt (top row) · Tt, tt (bottom row)

subs.text: Give the expected ratio of tall to short plants.

items.text: Part IV: English — Reading and Writing

Read the passage carefully, then answer the questions that follow.
The morning fog rolled slowly across the harbour, swallowing the fishing boats one by one until only their masts remained, thin and dark like the bones of some ancient creature. Gulls circled overhead, crying out in sharp, restless voices. On the quay, old Martha pulled her grey shawl tighter and watched the water, as she had done every morning for forty years. Somewhere beyond the fog, her son was coming home. The bell of the lighthouse rang out once, twice, and then fell silent, and the whole town seemed to hold its breath. Then, faint at first but growing stronger, came the steady chug of an engine, and a single yellow light appeared through the grey.
Find **two** adjectives in lines 1–3 that describe the masts or the gulls.
items.answer: Any two of: thin, dark, ancient, sharp, restless

items.text: How does the writer create a sense of *tension* in the passage? Refer to the text in your answer.
items.answer: Marking points: the fog hides the boats (uncertainty) · the lighthouse bell falls silent · “the whole town seemed to hold its breath” · the slow build-up of the engine sound and the single light. 1 mark per developed point with a quotation.

items.text: **Writing.** Write an essay of 250–300 words about a moment when you were waiting for something important. Plan your answer first. Your essay will be marked using the rubric on page 2.
items.answer: Mark with the rubric: Ideas & content (4), Organisation (4), Language & style (4), Grammar & spelling (3).

items.text: Part V: Physics & Maths
The circuit diagram shows a $6\,\mathrm{V}$ battery, a component **X**, a lamp and an ammeter **A**.

subs.text: The resistance of **X** is $3\,\Omega$ and the lamp has negligible resistance. Calculate the current. Show your working.
subs.answer: $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{6}{3} = 2\,\mathrm{A}$ (1 mark formula, 1 mark substitution, 1 mark answer with unit)

subs.text: A second lamp is added in series. State and explain what happens to the brightness of the first lamp.
subs.answer: It gets dimmer (1) because the total resistance increases, so the current decreases (1).

Calculate the average speed of the trolley using $v = \frac{d}{t}$. Show your working.

Evaluate the integral and give an exact answer.
$$\int_0^2 \left(3x^2 + 1\right)dx$$
The graph shows $y = x^2 - 4$ and $y = 2x - 1$. Write down the coordinates of the points **P** and **Q** where the two graphs meet.
Sketch the graph of $y = (x-1)^2$, marking where it meets the axes.
items.answer: U-shaped parabola, vertex (1, 0) touching the x-axis, crossing the y-axis at (0, 1).
